timestampConvention: Source times are relative to the decoded, gapless MP3 at t=0. Source and prepared sample positions use a common 48000 Hz clock. No speed change: within each kept segment, masterTime = masterStartSeconds + sourceTime - sourceStartSeconds.
asrMappingAdvice: Transcribe originals or the prepared master. When using original word times, map each word through its file keptSegments; no kept speech is retimed.
verificationLimit: Silence selection is signal-based with a conservative breath guard; this is a reversible preparatory edit, not a claimed listening or final editorial review.
